title: Teenage Robert Temple helps Arthur Young draft The Reflexive Universe

tellings.quote: he actually helped Arthur write the first draft of the reflexive universe.

plain: In Philadelphia in the 1960s, a teenager named Robert Temple is said to have helped a thinker named Arthur Young write the first draft of Young's book The Reflexive Universe. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove passes this on to Michels as something he heard from people in that circle, saying Temple "actually helped Arthur write the first draft." If so, Temple was working on big ideas about mind and the universe while still very young.
